body.message:
Hello Liberty,

Thank you for reaching out and for checking with us.

We completely understand your concerns, especially after reading the previous reviews. We would like to reassure you that everything is currently in good condition. The previous issues mentioned in the reviews have been addressed, and the apartment and facilities are now operating normally.

The AC is working properly, and there are currently no ceiling leakage issues. The pool and Jacuzzi are also maintained by the building management and are functioning normally.

We hope this gives you peace of mind. Please feel free to let us know if you have any other questions, we’ll be happy to assist you.
